newsitem.title: LATVIA: Nine firms bid to buy Latvian Shipping - report.
newsitem.headline: Nine firms bid to buy Latvian Shipping - report.

text.p: Nine companies entered bids to privatise one of Latvia's largest companies, Latvian Shipping, including Nomura and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), a newspaper said on Monday.

Newspaper Dienas Bizness said Nomura had joined with Estonian-based Hansa Investments and Norwegian Marsoft to form a consortium to bid for the Latvian Shipping Company, which is reckoned to be the world's 19th largest shipping group.
The Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA), which is handling the bid process, was not available to confirm the report. The newspaper said the EBRD was another of the bidders.
Latvian Shipping made a $51 million loss in 1995 after a $29 million loss in 1994. It has 70 ships and some 4,500 employees.
The investors in the company are expected to be able to buy between 25 percent and 35 percent of the firm.
